g.text: Jev follow-up: fixed ROI gates, routing replay and OOF calibration

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536575

g.text: Viewed development set: 120 sources | 60 anomalies + 60 normal images | fixed candidate and decision rules

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536575

g.text: Scope: the Teacher trained on 96/120 query sources; the remaining 24 contain only 2 normal images. These are viewed development diagnostics.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536575

g.text: Candidates: 60/120 union-95% boxes cover the full image and have identical query/crop pixels. ROI mean-IoU delta = +0.00118; paired 95% CI crosses zero.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536575

g.text: Budget: panel B shows replay budgets, not actual bills; all 240 paired calls were collected (+38 failed attempts). Random seed 44 overlaps the uncertainty point.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #536575

g.text: Calibration: whole-image scores only; OOF protocol formed after ROI evaluation but before calibration fitting. No independent calibration or confirmation was completed.
